messages.content: You answer questions about the 2026 FIFA World Cup. If you need a fact, call the tools instead of guessing. Mention the 2026 FIFA World Cup in your search queries. When the answer is ready, write it as the last line in the format FINAL: <answer>. The FINAL answer must be in English, with names and terms spelled exactly as in the source article; write numbers as digits; give a short phrase, no explanation. If you could not find the answer, write FINAL: unknown.
Which country will host the 2026 FIFA World Cup final?

function.name: web_search
function.description: Searches English Wikipedia and returns the intro of the best article and the titles of two more

query.description: short query: a name, a title, a term

function.name: page_find
function.description: Looks inside the full text of a Wikipedia article (for example '2026 in Japan') and returns the lines containing the keywords

keywords.description: two to five keywords from the question
